blocks.text: The Boise Boys are back, and we’ve got something HUGE in the works! Luke and Clint are teaming up again for a brand new show that’ll keep you hooked. Not only will you soon be able to catch them on a free streaming channel, but you’ll get an up-close look at our design decisions and home tutorials like never before!
“People keep asking ‘where’s the Boise Boys? When are you going to be back?’ It’s been going on but we’ve just had to be patient while we’ve had things in the works.”
We’re excited to announce that filming is set to begin this year!

We’re gearing up for our most exciting and educational season yet, and we can’t wait to share it with you. Whether you’re a DIY enthusiast or just love great home transformations, this show is going to be your new obsession!

Idaho Press just dropped an amazing article that gives you a sneak peek into what’s coming. It’s packed with exciting details about the new show, including how it’ll differ from “Boise Boys” and “Outgrown“. Think shorter episodes with a laser focus on design decisions and home tutorials – it’s going to be a goldmine of practical tips and inspiration!

Want to get the full inside scoop? Head over to Idaho Press’s website and check out the entire article. Trust us, it’ll make you even more pumped for what’s coming next! Stay tuned for all the details—this is just the beginning of something amazing!

The article dives deep into Luke’s journey, from his days as a touring musician to building a realty firm, his current success as the founder of Timber and Love Realty, now recognized as a top 1% real estate firm in Boise. You’ll also get the inside scoop on how Timber and Love Design|Build came to be, and the heartwarming story behind Luke’s family, including their inspiring adoption journey.
